[non-codebase] Independent-review identity evidence for AC3:
- Implementation/editing session: `/root/audit_generic_reconciler_plans`; it authored the five docstring edits and reported one successful prose pass (an earlier atomic patch attempt changed nothing).
- Independent before/final reviewer session: `/root/review_goldfilled_comments`; it inventoried base `baa9ee651c8ee409fbb02f3e9066e71c7dd3ced2` before final review, compared final commit `ce069321dc3edc3d16b69a812af16727c10c0d29`, posted the five-row TSV receipt, and made no source/commit/push changes.
- These are distinct harness sessions with held-out roles. Both tracker comments carry author_id `594c-9dcf-5ad6-4e6d` only because the on-box MCP server signs all tracker writes with its shared registered Rebar Bot identity; that signer identifies the transport environment, not which agent session authored or reviewed the source.
- The TSV `reviewer_session` column records `/root/review_goldfilled_comments:8455-598a-8245-4f4b`, tying every row to the independent reviewer session.
